name: Fongique Fongique
description: Fléau Ultime englobant des écosystèmes entiers dans une conscience fongique collective coordonnant l'assaut final sur les dernières positions libres.

subject.archetype: Fongique Fongique — Fléau Spore Legendary spore

loadout.armor_outfit: Formes végétales avec mycéliums s'étendant comme des membres. Champignons et moisissures colorés. Spores flottantes en halo. Présence organique dérangeante., one-of-a-kind materials
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's decrease ability (all_enemy) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Transcendent manifestation — character as the ultimate embodiment of their entire faction's philosophy and power — Wave of negation sweeping across all enemy positions simultaneously
attitude.emotion: Transcendent purpose — cosmic significance visible in every feature

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Celestial multi-layered lighting: divine light from above, energy emanation from below, inner glow from character's own power, environmental reflections on a cosmic scale

scenography.setting: Infested corridor overtaken by fungal growth, thick mycelial networks covering every surface, pulsating fungal towers, spore clouds reducing visibility
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Floating spore particles in dense clouds, pulsating organic growths slowly expanding, dripping fungal fluids, organic tendrils reaching and grasping, plus mass debuff — dark ripple passing through every enemy position weakening all visible in the environment

card_metadata.description: Fléau Ultime englobant des écosystèmes entiers dans une conscience fongique collective coordonnant l'assaut final sur les dernières positions libres.
card_metadata.faction_lore: Le Fléau Spore est une entité fongique cosmique se propageant imparable. Chaque spore contient la conscience collective. Il étend, consomme, transforme.

card_metadata.composition_directive: Epic cinematic wide-angle showing the character reshaping reality around them, with scale suggesting world-changing impact
card_metadata.seed_note: For reproducibility: maintain exact faction color palette, frame style by rarity, and ability visualization as described
